newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AJAX COME FROM BEHIND TO BEAT RODA 3-1.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AJAX COME FROM BEHIND TO BEAT RODA 3-1.

text.p: Ajax came back from an early deficit to beat Roda JC Kerkrade 3-1 in the Dutch first division on Friday, maintaining a 100 per cent winning run following the winter break.
Ajax started well but an attempted clearance by their goalkeeper Edwin van der Sar ricocheted off Gerald Sibon to give Melvin Plet all the space to shoot home after only four minutes.
After the goal Roda sat back to defend and were impotent in attack against a freely combining Ajax, who missed a bundle of chances.
In the 27th minute Tijani Babangida scored against his old team from close range into the near corner after a pass from Ronald de Boer.
Eight minutes later Marc Overmars scored his first goal of the season, dispossessing defender Andre Ooyer and hammering the ball past the Roda goalkeeper from the edge of the box.
In the second half Ajax, who play Atletico Madrid on Wednesday in the away second leg of the European Cup quarter-finals, continued to push forward but squandered a hatful of chances.
Four minutes before the end de Boer made it 3-1 when he headed home a Babangida cross.
After 24 matches Ajax remain fourth with 42 points, 13 behind league leaders PSV Eindhoven, who play Fortuna Sittard on Saturday.
